reset_fee: Evaluation resets: Zero $79/$149/$249 (25K/50K/100K); Standard $109/$199/$289 (50K/100K/150K); Advanced $189/$319/$449 (50K/100K/150K). Qualified resets (Zero/Standard only, max 2 per account, within 7 days of breach, only if no payout requested): Zero $399/$499/$799, Standard $599/$799/$999.
refund_policy: No general refund terms on the help centre (main-site /return-policy/ blocked). Full refund of a passed or active Evaluation if the trader fails KYC screening. Monthly rebill resets a failed evaluation; subscription can be cancelled in the dashboard.
time_limit: No deadline stated; evaluation subscription rebills monthly until you pass or cancel
scaling_plan: Zero (50K/100K) and Standard Qualified accounts: contract limits grow with profit (e.g. Standard 150K 3 minis under $1,500 profit up to 15 minis at $4,500+). No scaling plan on Advanced or Direct. Top performers can be called to live capital (Live Program 80% split or Alpha Prime 60%).
ea_bots: banned (AI, bots and full automation prohibited; semi-automated signal indicators allowed if trades are placed and managed manually; no 100+ trades/day strategies)
inactivity_rule: Must place at least one trade every 10 trading days (evaluation and qualified)
notes: Zero/Standard/Advanced are monthly subscriptions; Direct is one-time. Activation fee $0 for accounts bought after 2026-07-08 ($149 per Advanced Qualified before). Copy trading only for a single trader across own accounts; cross-account or same-account opposite positions (hedging) prohibited. Prohibited: tick scalping (<10 ticks AND <2 min as a pattern), order-book spamming, account rolling/stacking, group trading, VPN; no trading within 2% of CME price limits. All trades closed by 4:20pm ET. Max position per account e.g. Advanced 50K 5 minis/50 micros. Min payout varies: Zero $200, Standard/Direct $500, Advanced $1,000. KYC via Veriff required before Qualified account/payouts; payment card name must match KYC. Evaluations can be paid by card or crypto (CoinPayments: ETH, USDT, USDC, SOL).
